description: Run a MicroPython firmware update via the app's updateLoaderFirmwareMpy (START_MPY_UPDATE). Writes mpy.img and REBOOTS the board. DESTRUCTIVE — requires confirm=true after explicit user approval. Default path upgrades to the built-in RC MPY (mpyType=1); passing userMpyConfig targets a design MPY. Experimental: the built-in path still needs live validation (see docs/MPY固件链路笔记.md).

checksum0.description: MPY checksum for the upgrade check; defaults to empty (built-in path).

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user has explicitly approved this specific upgrade on this specific device.

eraseFirmwareConfig.description: Also erase the board RC config after upgrade (app behavior step 13).

mpyType.description: 0 = user_mpy (design MPY, requires userMpyConfig), 1 = cb_rc (built-in RC MPY).

target.description: Which device to target — pass exactly one field. If omitted, the app must know exactly one device; ambiguous or unmatched targets are refused.

userMpyConfig.description: Design MPY config {title, microPython:{uniKey, checkSum0}} — required when mpyType=0.

name: flash_mpy
title: MicroPython firmware update
